comparison.scope: conditional on realized first-hurdle event and observable order; ET252 uses different model and inputs

interpretation: ET252 AUC point estimate is 0.476606 and native is 0.426768 on the same 1042 known first-hit parents.
ET252 minus native AUC is +0.049839; the fixed paired day interval excludes zero while the paired week interval includes zero. The joint day/week evidence does not establish a robust difference.

ET252 uses an ExtraTrees classifier and a different full-snapshot input, so the contrast does not isolate architecture or feature value. Both scores were trained for endpoint sign, not this first-hit outcome.

This is an exploratory comparison after examining the native result, on one repeatedly reused TRAIN-development fold selected on a realized >10bps gross quote event. It neither estimates all-parent performance nor establishes trading edge or causal feature contribution.
limits: One reused TRAIN-development fold and realized first-hurdle-selected parents.
Same-row AUCs do not establish causality, generalization or trading edge.
